'''Farn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Separatist War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed in [[Fort Garnik]]. He personally welcomed a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising sergeant]], and future legendary [[Havoc Squad]]'s commander, upon the sergeant's arrival in the Fort.
{{GameLS}}
After the Sergeant returned to the fort, Farn explained that most soldiers in the base were corrupt, and he could only trust the only person inside, revealing that his CO, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Virk]], was scamming everyone under his command. He also said that [[Farn's buddy|one]] of his squad-mates, who tried to report Lt. Virk was sent on a death assignment the next day, where he died. The Sergeant accepted to help the young private, saying that as a Havoc Squad member, and reported the situation to the higher authorities, alerting them about Virk's ongoing scam and corruption. Virk was court-martialed, and Farn sent the sergeant a letter of thanks.
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is also possible that the player doesn't report Virk, and tells him about Farn, who is later sent on another death assignment. It is also possible, that the player [[Dueling|duels]] and [[Death/Legends|kills]] Virk and his men, resulting in Farn and his squad getting a new squad leader.
